cover_headline: Indian Americans Keep Six House Seats as Ramaswamy Loses Ohio Governor Race
facts: Six Indian Americans were elected to the US House of Representatives, matching the community's record
Pia Dandiya in Florida and Amish Shah in Arizona are the two newcomers in the House
Vivek Ramaswamy, endorsed by President Trump, lost the Ohio governor's race to Democrat Amy Acton

end.headline: Indian Americans Keep Six House Seats as Ramaswamy Loses Ohio Governor Race
end.line: A post-election tally counted 30 Indian-American wins in state legislative races, and Nithya Raman won the Los Angeles mayor's race.
